newsitem.title: INDIA: India BSE in delayed start on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: India BSE in delayed start on Wednesday.

text.p: Trading at India's Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) will start 30 minutes late at 1030 hours (0500 GMT) on Wednesday due to the death of a member-broker, exchange officials said.
The BSE is normally open for trade from 1000 hours (0430 GMT) to 1530 hours (1000 GMT).
Bombay's benchmark index closed 32.01 points, or 0.77 percent, higher on Tuesday, propped up by foreign fund buying, dealers said.
